name: Trees Poker
description: Poker variant with a tree-themed or environmental twist. Players receive five cards face-down, post an ante, and play one round of betting (check, bet, call, raise, or fold) before showdown; highest standard poker hand wins the pot.

overview.description: Poker variant with a tree-themed or environmental twist. Players receive five cards face-down, post an ante, and play one round of betting (check, bet, call, raise, or fold) before showdown; highest standard poker hand wins the pot.

history.origins: Poker spread from the United States in the 19th century. Trees Poker is a thematic variant with tree or environmental twist; specific origin and history are not documented in available sources.
timeline: 19th century: Poker spread from the United States; Trees Poker is a thematic variant with tree or environmental twist.

setup.deck: One standard 52-card deck with French suits (Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades); no jokers. Same composition as standard poker.
setup.dealing: Dealer shuffles; player to dealer's right cuts. Dealer deals five cards face-down to each player, one at a time, clockwise from the player to dealer's left.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the best five-card hand at showdown.
rules.gameplay: Players receive five cards face-down. After an ante and a round of betting (check, bet, call, raise, or fold), remaining players reveal hands; highest standard poker hand wins the pot. Tree-themed or environmental twist may apply to table stakes or house rules.
keyRules: Standard poker hand rankings. Betting proceeds clockwise; players may check, bet, call, raise, or fold. Last aggressor or first active player shows first at showdown.

strategy.basic: Value hands by standard poker rankings; fold weak hands when facing a bet.
strategy.intermediate: Consider position and opponent tendencies; use pot odds when calling.
strategy.advanced: Balance bluffing and value betting; adjust to table dynamics and stack sizes.
tips: Tree-themed house rules may affect stakes or side pots; confirm before play.

variations.name: No Limit
variations.description: Play with no maximum bet; any bet up to full stack is allowed.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: No Limit is a stake variant; overrides apply at table level, not in engine constants.

scoring.description: Pot is won by the player with the highest standard poker hand at showdown; if all but one fold, that player wins without showing.
scoring.winCondition: Highest standard poker hand at showdown wins the pot.
